levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حدثني من سأله» is an unnamed link (rule 8): the man who asked the Imam.

The Imam is named only in the editor's gloss «- يعني الصادق عليه السلام -» and his answer follows; he is taken as the one asked (rule 5, owner ruling 2). The gloss is the only place the name stands; a reviewer should confirm.
«أبي» (the compiler's father) is a relation, no name.
